title: 特朗普白宫推出MAGA版Snake、Flappy Bird、Tetris等游戏
content:
Trump’s White House has made MAGA versions of Snake, Flappy Bird, Tetris and more – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
The US government has developed five webgames that put a MAGA spin on several classic mobile and console games.
The new
Arcade.gov
portal on the US government’s website now hosts its own versions of Snake, Flappy Bird, Tetris and Duck Hunt, and promises more to come.
The MAGA spin on Flappy Bird is called Flappy Bill, and replaces the yellow bird and green pipes of the original with a bald eagle and White House-like columns.
Snake is reworked as Rio Run, and asks players to pick up and deport a growing line of people crossing the Rio Grande. There’s also a version of Tetris in which players build a wall to “protect the border from the coming horde”.
Trump Savings Tycoon is a Duck Hunt-like game where players tap or click the flying items to deposit them in their Trump account. Supply Line sees players tap unhealthy food items on a conveyor belt to remove them from a child’s school lunch.
The five games as they appear on arcade.gov.
There’s at least one more game coming soon to the new games portal – a sixth spot on the webpage says players should “stay tuned” and that “a new adventure awaits”.
The White House-made games were announced on X using videos that use old
Xbox
,
PlayStation
,
Nintendo
and
Sega
console start-up sequences.
The US government also posted a Pac-Man like image that reads ‘
Trump Arcade
’ with the message “Enter the arcade of winning”.
